$comment: Loomling-owned design-check rule set (CLAUDE.md §22, system/design-check.md). This file is the source of truth for WHAT the advisory design check evaluates. Edit it freely as taste evolves — no code change needed. CC runs these rules against the RENDERED preview, never raw source.

rules.note: WCAG AA: body text 4.5:1, large/bold 3:1. Mirrors system/accessibility.md (hard rule there).
Heading level skip (h1->h3). Mirrors system/seo.md (hard rule there).
Discount intentional Loomling slots: [data-loom-slot][src=''] renders a placeholder by design (system/seo.md §image discipline). Only flag genuinely broken images in the rendered output.
Content wider than its container / forced horizontal scroll.
Text flush against a bordered/colored edge.
Lines wider than ~80ch. Loomling caps via --measure (system/typography.md).
Thick colored border on one side of a card (side-stripe).
More than ~2 em-dashes in rendered body copy. Count RENDERED text only — never CSS custom properties.

off.$comment: Everything not listed in `rules` is OFF by default (the user's 'taste is the highest authority' principle). Examples deliberately left off: overused-font, single-font, flat-type-hierarchy, cream-palette, ai-color-palette, hero-eyebrow-chip, repeated-section-kickers, numbered-section-markers, italic-serif-display, icon-tile-stack, monotonous-spacing, marketing-buzzword, aphoristic-cadence, bounce-easing, dark-glow, nested-cards. Move any of these into `rules` to enable; they become advisories, never blocks.
